_comment: C-first trap.c:dountrap -> untrap -> disarm_holdingtrap case. The Wizard moves off the upstairs, applies an uncursed disarmed beartrap to set a known floor bear trap, remains untrapped on that square, and uses #untrap in direction . to disarm it. v6 beartrap histories wish a trap or sit on/trigger one; this action instead disarms a known empty floor bear trap.
